notes.modes: Florida's results file carries no early or election-day column. Florida posts vote-by-mail and early voting at poll close, before any election-day precinct reports, so the board at that moment IS the early vote; it is banked once and everything after is exact subtraction. Until it is banked there is no mode split and the precinct scaling stays switched off, because dividing a Florida county's whole total would scale an early vote that is already complete and is most of the ballots.
notes.election_day: Ballots still to come on election day are not estimated; only precincts not yet reporting are shown.
